crossRefs.note: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died.

parallels.note: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and…
When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.
So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armor bearer, and all his men, that same day together.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died.
translations.bsb: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his own sword and died.
